exposure: Presence of genetic or chromosomal disorders
outcome: Prevalence of CHD diagnosed in the first year of life
cohort: The study included 245,120 live births, representing all children born in Northern Ireland between 2005 and 2014.
finding: Northern Ireland exhibited a high prevalence of major congenital heart defects (12.48 per 1,000 live births) among live births from 2005 to 2014, with the prevalence of CHD diagnosed in the first year of life increasing over time.
followup_time: Up to the first year of life (for diagnosis)
cross-section timing: Data collected on live births occurring between 2005 and 2014
